signature_engine_enabled.title: Signature Engine Enabled
signature_engine_enabled.description: Whether the signature-based detection engine is actively enabled and processing traffic

signature_library_age_days.title: Signature Library Age (Days)
signature_library_age_days.description: Number of days since the signature library was last updated

covered_protocol_categories.title: Covered Protocol Categories
covered_protocol_categories.description: List of protocol categories for which signatures are actively applied (e.g., HTTP, DNS, SMB, TLS, FTP, SMTP)

signature_action_mode.title: Signature Action Mode
signature_action_mode.description: The operational mode determining what action is taken when a signature matches

baseline_established.title: Traffic Baseline Established
baseline_established.description: Indicates whether a statistical baseline of normal traffic patterns has been established and is actively used for anomaly detection comparisons.

model_training_status.title: ML Model Training Status
model_training_status.description: Current operational state of the machine learning models used for anomaly detection, indicating whether models are trained and actively deployed.

baseline_observation_days.title: Baseline Observation Period (Days)
baseline_observation_days.description: Number of days of traffic data used to build the behavioral baseline. Shorter periods produce lower-quality baselines with higher false positive/negative rates.

anomaly_detection_sensitivity.title: Anomaly Detection Sensitivity Level
anomaly_detection_sensitivity.description: Configured sensitivity threshold for anomaly scoring — determines whether the system is tuned to detect deviations. Disabled means anomaly detection is turned off regardless of model state.

dpi_enabled.title: Deep Packet Inspection Enabled
dpi_enabled.description: Whether deep packet inspection is actively enabled and processing traffic payloads beyond header analysis

inspection_layers.title: Inspected Protocol Layers
inspection_layers.description: List of protocol layers or application-layer protocols actively inspected by the DPI engine (e.g., HTTP, DNS, SMTP, TLS, FTP)

encrypted_traffic_inspection_mode.title: Encrypted Traffic Inspection Mode
encrypted_traffic_inspection_mode.description: The method used to inspect encrypted traffic — consolidates DPI-layer mode and dedicated encrypted traffic inspection method into a single canonical attribute.

inspection_actively_enabled.title: Encrypted Traffic Inspection Actively Enabled
inspection_actively_enabled.description: Whether the configured encrypted traffic inspection mechanism is currently active and processing traffic

encrypted_traffic_coverage_percentage.title: Encrypted Traffic Coverage Percentage
encrypted_traffic_coverage_percentage.description: Percentage of encrypted traffic flows passing through monitoring inspection points

deployment_mode.title: Deployment Mode
deployment_mode.description: Whether the network monitoring system is deployed inline (prevention-capable) or in passive/tap mode (detection-only)

automated_blocking_enabled.title: Automated Blocking Enabled
automated_blocking_enabled.description: Whether automatic traffic blocking or session termination actions are enabled upon threat detection, as opposed to alert-only mode

response_actions_configured.title: Configured Response Actions
response_actions_configured.description: List of automated response actions configured for confirmed threat detections (e.g., block, quarantine, session_reset, rate_limit)

prevention_policy_status.title: Prevention Policy Status
prevention_policy_status.description: Operational status of the active prevention policy applied to monitored traffic

traffic_logging_enabled.title: Traffic Logging Enabled
traffic_logging_enabled.description: Whether the network traffic monitoring system has logging actively enabled for flow records, session metadata, and alert events

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days that traffic logs, flow records, and alert events are retained before deletion or archival

logged_data_types.title: Logged Data Types
logged_data_types.description: List of data categories being captured by the traffic monitoring system (e.g., flow_records, session_metadata, alert_events, packet_captures)

siem_export_enabled.title: SIEM Export Enabled
siem_export_enabled.description: Whether the system is actively exporting alerts and telemetry to a SIEM or SOAR platform

export_format.title: Telemetry Export Format
export_format.description: The standardized format used to export alerts and telemetry data to downstream platforms

export_destination_count.title: Number of Configured Export Destinations
export_destination_count.description: Count of active downstream SIEM, SOAR, or threat intelligence platform destinations receiving telemetry

last_successful_export_hours_ago.title: Hours Since Last Successful Export
last_successful_export_hours_ago.description: Number of hours elapsed since the last confirmed successful telemetry delivery to a downstream platform

internal_segment_sensor_coverage.title: Internal Segment Sensor Coverage
internal_segment_sensor_coverage.description: Extent to which network sensors are deployed across east-west internal traffic segments and broader network segments including cloud, OT, and remote access paths.

lateral_movement_signatures_enabled.title: Lateral Movement Signatures Enabled
lateral_movement_signatures_enabled.description: Whether detection signatures or behavioral rules for lateral movement indicators (e.g., internal scanning, credential relay, SMB/WMI/RPC abuse) are active and up to date

east_west_alert_response_integration.title: East-West Alert Response Integration
east_west_alert_response_integration.description: Level of integration between east-west traffic detection alerts and active response or ticketing systems

sensor_health_verified.title: Sensor Health Verified
sensor_health_verified.description: Indicates whether deployed sensors have been confirmed as operational and actively forwarding traffic to the detection platform within the last monitoring cycle

false_positive_tuning_enabled.title: False Positive Tuning Enabled
false_positive_tuning_enabled.description: Indicates whether active false positive tuning mechanisms (rule suppression, whitelisting, threshold calibration) are configured and operational in the network traffic monitoring system.

alert_fidelity_review_frequency.title: Alert Fidelity Review Frequency
alert_fidelity_review_frequency.description: How frequently the tuning rules, whitelists, and thresholds are reviewed and updated to maintain alert fidelity.

suppression_rule_count.title: Active Suppression Rule Count
suppression_rule_count.description: Number of active suppression or whitelist rules currently configured in the monitoring system to reduce false positive alerts.

threat_feed_integration_enabled.title: Threat Intelligence Feed Integration Enabled
threat_feed_integration_enabled.description: Whether external threat intelligence feeds (IP reputation, domain blacklists, malware hashes) are actively integrated into the detection system

feed_refresh_interval_hours.title: Feed Refresh Interval (Hours)
feed_refresh_interval_hours.description: How frequently (in hours) the threat intelligence feeds are updated/refreshed from upstream sources

active_feed_types.title: Active Feed IOC Types
active_feed_types.description: List of IOC categories actively ingested from threat feeds (e.g., 'ip_reputation', 'domain_blacklist', 'malware_hash', 'url_blacklist')
